name: homeovet-app
description: HomeoVet — Base educacional de homeopatia veterinária: web app (React), API (Node/Express), Electron desktop, MCP server e GitHub Pages

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix mcp install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"

author: Jean Avila
